name: codex-blackbox
description: Explore projects with a simple input → process → output diagram. Click to reveal children, data, and decision evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Understand project behavior, data, and user/AI decisions.
interface.longDescription: Read source and available local project chats, then explore an offline input → process → output diagram. Click a process to drill into its children or click data for a compact detail card. Decisions, approvals, and source evidence appear only when requested.
defaultPrompt: Visualize this whole project as BlackBox input → process → output boxes, including children, data structures, and user versus AI decisions.
